name: Hàn Tín
role: Han general under Liu Bang, later king of Qi and Chu, demoted to Marquis of Huaiyin
known_facts: Born in Huaiyin, poor; Shiji records the humiliation of crawling between a bully's legs
Left Xiang Yu for Liu Bang in 206 BC; Xiao He chased him down and recommended him as grand general
Defeated Zhao at Jingxing in 204 BC with the back-to-the-river formation
Flooded and destroyed Long Ju's Chu army at the Wei River in 203 BC
Made king of Qi in 203 BC, commanded the encirclement of Xiang Yu at Gaixia in 202 BC
Demoted in 201 BC and killed in the Changle Palace in 196 BC; three clans extinguished
interpretation: Early Western Han general, based on the user reference.
unknowns: Whether he truly plotted rebellion is debated
